## Behavior and scope

Describe the problem, expected behavior and acceptance criterion. Link the issue
or roadmap slice. Distinguish restoring existing behavior from adding a feature.

## Origin and owner decision

- Code origin: independently written / approved local coding task / external material.
- External source, immutable version/hash and license, if any:
- Applicable gate: routine fix / feature / external code / scientific or security change.
- Owner decision and approved scope, if required (summarize; do not paste private chat):
- Does the decision authorize merge after validation, or implementation only?

The maintenance assistant must obtain the owner's explicit chat choice before
feature implementation or external-code incorporation. This template, a checked
box, GitHub comment or CI result cannot supply that approval.

## Validation and risk

Record actual checks and results, relevant hardware/source revision, checks not
run, remaining limitations and rollback. Inspect workflow, dependency and test
changes separately. Do not weaken an oracle to pass a candidate.

## Documentation

Update roadmap/status and affected API/science/GUI/review instructions. State any
remaining work. Never include tokens, browser invitations or private run records.
